title: USG-UAP-D001, Congressional, White House, UFO-related Constituent Correspondence, 1998
doc_notes: This document is a collection of 1998 correspondence between the White House, members of Congress, and NASA regarding constituent inquiries about UFOs, astronaut sightings, and requests for congressional hearings.

incidents.summary: A constituent reported observing a light rising vertically from the bottom of the screen while watching a NASA shuttle mission broadcast, which was then tracked by the shuttle camera before the feed was cut.
incidents.quote: As I watched, I was surprised to see a light rising vertically from the bottom of the screen

incidents.summary: Major Gordon Cooper reported seeing a glowing, greenish object approaching his Mercury capsule during his 22nd orbit.
incidents.quote: I could see a glowing, greenish object ahead of him quickly approaching his capsule.

incidents.summary: Major Gordon Cooper observed multiple saucer-shaped discs flying in formation over Western Germany.
incidents.quote: They were metallic, saucer-shaped discs at considerable altitude and could out-maneuver all American fighter planes.

incidents.summary: Astronauts Ed White and James McDivitt observed a metallic object with arms while passing over Hawaii.
incidents.quote: they saw a weird-looking metallic object. The UFO had long arms sticking out of it.

incidents.summary: Astronauts James Lovell and Frank Borman reported a bogey during their Gemini 7 flight.
incidents.quote: GOT A BOGEY AT 10 O'CLOCK HIGH.

incidents.summary: Apollo 11 astronauts reported seeing spacecraft on the far side of a crater edge on the Moon.
incidents.quote: I'm telling you there are other spacecraft out there,. Lined up on the far side of the crater edge!

incidents.summary: Donald Slayton observed a gray, saucer-shaped disk while testing a P-51 fighter.
incidents.quote: It looked like a saucer, a disk.

incidents.summary: Major Robert White reported a grayish object during an X-15 flight.
incidents.quote: It was grayish in color and about thirty to forty feet away.

incidents.summary: NASA pilot Joseph Walker filmed five or six UFOs during an X-15 flight.
incidents.quote: He had filmed five or six UFOs during his record breaking fifty-mile-high flight

incidents.summary: Astronaut James F. Buchli reported observing an alien spacecraft during Shuttle Discovery mission 20.
incidents.quote: Houston, this is Riscovery, we still have the alien spacecraft under observance
